title: This is something new!
text: This is something new!. Might take a while to get used to this new way of preserving food.  The “kit” includes reusable sandwich and produce bags, which can be washed, and 3 beeswax food wraps - made of natural beeswax.  They are sticky - and the info included warns us of that - and they are for wrapping around cheese, nuts, fruits, etc.  They can be washed in cool water and reused - and stored in the fridge.  Our jury is still out on the beeswax wraps - as they degrade with time, and we’re struggling to see the gain from their use.  Interesting idea - time will tell.

product_metadata.title: Beeswax Food Wrap (3 Pcs), Reusable Sandwich Bags (2 Large & 6 Medium) & Reusable Produce Bags (2 Large, 2 Medium & 2 Small) - Beeswax Wrap, Snacks Bags, Grocery Mesh Bag, Washable,Clear,Set of 17 Pcs
features: 【FOOD GRADE MATERIAL】Food storage bag & Beeswax wrap are made of food grade material, healthy and Safe for food storage.Produce bags & Food storage bags have been thickened (thicker than others), and can be reused again and again for a long time. Beeswax Wrap is made from organic cotton, beeswax, organic jojoba oil, and tree resin, all natural, have no scent, more safe. Provide a natural seal for your food, allowing it to stay fresh for longer.

【BEESWAX WRAP】Use the warmth of your hands to soften the wrap and form over a container or a piece of food. As the wrap cools, it creates a seal to naturally stores food. It can be reused again after gently washing with mild soap in cold water and air dry. (Don’t use hot water as the wax might melt). Hot food must be cooled down before being wrapped. Avoid microwaves, raw meat and more than a month of freezer use.

【PRODUCE MESH BAGS】Made of ultra fine yet strong mesh polyester, the bag is super lightweight, durable and perfect for food storage like tangerine,tomatoes, cauliflower, lettuce and beans even toys. No need to waste time double handling your produce when you get home from the market, simply wash the fruits and veggies in the bag, allow to dry,and store it in fridge directly. Each mesh bag has the potential to eliminate up to 1000 plastic bags over it's lifetime.

【REUSABLE STORAGE BAGS】One reusable bag can save up to 400pcs of plastic bags. They are perfect as sandwich bags, snack bags, lunch bags and freezer bags. The zipper has been improved to a wider edge and an anti-slip design that makes it easier to open or close. Easy to clean by hand wash in cold water and air dry. They're freezer safe and leak-proof.

【ZERO WASTE】We appreciate your support and your satisfaction is our first priority. The package includes: 8 Reusable Storage Bags(2 large & 6 medium), 6 Produce Mesh bags(2 Large, 2 Medium & 2 Small), and 3 different sizes Beeswax Wraps. Multi Sizes Meet All Your Need!
